section_summary.extract_value: This section details the methodology, including participants and measures. Participants consisted of 1621 Latino, East Asian, and European American university students recruited from Georgetown University, University of California, Irvine, and Arizona State University. Measures focused on dimensions of gratitude experience and expression using adapted items from Eid and Diener (2001). The section also mentions that information for 'both studies' is available in the online supplemental materials, indicating the paper includes at least two studies.
